name: Adra Nos Altier
source:
A fiery captain consumed with chasing threads of her fragmented past.

Despite her small stature, Adra's reputation is enormous. She's renowned as an infamous captain and treasure hunter; but her confident, stubborn personality veils a broken woman who's lost her sense of direction. Will she ever remember who she used to be?

[From in-app]
